hints.title: Product Total Quantity Aggregation
hints.text: Group sales records by product identifier and sum all quantities sold across all recorded transactions.

hints.title: Group By Product and Sum Quantity
hints.text: Group by product_id and apply sum(quantity) alias total_quantity.

hints.title: Total Quantity Blueprint
hints.text: select product_id, sum(quantity) as total_quantity from Sales group by product_id.

hints.title: Complete Implementation
hints.text:
```mysql
SELECT product_id, SUM(quantity) AS total_quantity
FROM Sales
GROUP BY product_id;
```

variables: S: number of records in Sales
complexity.notes: Single table hash aggregation computes quantity sums in linear scan time.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Joining the Product table adds unnecessary join overhead when all needed attributes are in Sales.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Group by directly on Sales table avoids auxiliary memory.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Recognizing that product_id and quantity are both present in the Sales table.

solutions.code:
import pandas as pd

def sales_analysis(sales: pd.DataFrame, product: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    grouped = sales.groupby('product_id')['quantity'].sum().reset_index()
    grouped.columns = ['product_id', 'total_quantity']
    return grouped
